description: This file contains the implementation of the GeoZone controller class within the OpenCart admin panel. It manages CRUD operations, listing, form display, and saving of geo zones, which are used for geolocation-based settings in the e-commerce platform.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Represents the GeoZone controller responsible for managing geographical zones used in store configuration. Extends the core Controller class and provides methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting geo zones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the geo zone management page, loads language and sets up data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of geo zones based on pagination, sorting, and filtering parameters.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Helper method that builds the data array with the list of geo zones, including pagination, sorting links, and other relevant data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a geo zone, populating fields with existing data if an ID is provided.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the POST request to create or update a geo zone, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected geo zones if the user has the required permissions.
